release_notes:
BatchFox 1.0.3.18 (beta): what's new since 1.0.3.17
- If BatchFox can't reach the license server after a while offline, it now keeps working on the Free plan instead of locking you out, and checks again when it reconnects. Restore stays available.
- If your account is blocked, BatchFox now opens a window that explains why and lets you keep restoring your files, instead of closing.
- License messages now always appear as a plain sentence, never raw server or error text.
- When none of the files you're archiving can be read, for example because another program has them open, BatchFox now says so plainly instead of a generic failure.
- When a photo can't be upscaled, its row now shows what went wrong, and the photo is never silently dropped from the batch.
- In Crop, the Crop button and Export come back as soon as a compose or export finishes.

Known issue: BatchFox can't fully archive ORF files from some Olympus and OM System cameras yet (OM-1 Mark II, E-M1 Mark II, E-M5 Mark III, E-M10 series, PEN-F, E-M1X). In a batch with other cameras, these files are still stored in the archive, byte for byte; in a batch of only these files, the archive stops and nothing is written. Either way, your original files are untouched. The OM-1, OM-3, OM-5, OM-5 Mark II, and E-M1 Mark III archive normally; support for the rest is on the way.

Known issue: If BatchFox pauses its tools so only Restore works, open the License window and sign in again. A fix that renews your sign-in automatically is on the way.
